title: Dimensionless Controls of Plasticity Under Alternating Tasks: From Evolutionary Biology to Continual Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.23889v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Plasticity under changing environments is central to both evolutionary biology and continual learning. Motivated by recent work on genotype--phenotype maps, we study a minimal deep-learning analogue where a network is trained alternately on two Boolean label sets, and ask which biological controls of plasticity survive the translation to gradient descent. Reinterpreting four proposed biological factors as quantities of training dynamics, we find the system reduces to two dimensionless controls: the task disagreement $r$, the fraction of disagreeing labels, and the reach $\eta T$, the product of learning rate and switching period. We derive two bounds on plasticity: $r$ alone fixes an extremal geometric floor on the utopia distance, while $r$ and $\eta T$ jointly bound forgetting. translated_title: 交替任务下可塑性的无量纲控制：从进化生物学到持续学习
translated_abstract: 摘要：环境变化下的可塑性是进化生物学和持续学习的核心问题。受近期基因型-表型图谱研究的启发，我们研究了一个最小深度学习类比，其中网络在两组布尔标签上交替训练，并探讨哪些生物学上的可塑性控制因素能够转化为梯度下降过程。我们将四个提出的生物学因素重新解释为训练动态的量，发现系统简化为两个无量纲控制变量：任务不一致性$r$（不一致标签的比例）和到达度$\eta T$（学习率与切换周期的乘积）。我们推导出关于可塑性的两个界限：$r$单独决定了乌托邦距离的极值几何下限，而$r$和$\eta T$共同约束遗忘。在9,720条轨迹中，方差分析确认$r$、$\eta$和$T$起主导作用，而中性集大小（在生物学环境中被强调）的影响则相对次要。
tldr: 本研究将进化生物学中的可塑性控制因素映射到持续学习，发现两个无量纲参数（任务不一致性和学习率与周期的乘积）主导了交替训练下的可塑性边界，并验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: This study maps plasticity controls from evolutionary biology to continual learning, revealing that two dimensionless parameters—task disagreement and the product of learning rate and period—dominate plasticity bounds under alternating training, with empirical validation across thousands of trajectories.
